tests.summary: Classic Search input has a visible, unobscured focus indicator
tests.description: Validate the Classic Search input focus state against WCAG 2.4.11.

steps.action: Open Classic Search with the keyboard
steps.result: The layer opens and focus enters the layer

steps.action: Tab to the search input
steps.result: The input receives a clearly visible focus indicator

steps.action: Check the input against surrounding overlay and header content
steps.result: The focused input is not fully obscured

xray_metadata.gherkin:
Given the Search Layer is available
When a user completes classic search input has a visible, unobscured focus indicator
Then the expected accessibility behavior is met
